inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped MySQL query computes sample standard deviation with STDDEV_SAMP.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored station group with two DECIMAL readings and one NULL reading. It isolates STDDEV_SAMP recognition, sample-versus-population math, and NULL omission without joins or multiple groups.

fixture_notes: The single station has readings 10.00 and 14.00 plus NULL, so sample standard deviation is sqrt(8); the NULL must be ignored.
determinism_notes: Sample IDs and the single station ID are fixed; the result is ordered by the unique station ID. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_station_voltage (sample_id INT PRIMARY KEY, station_id INT NOT NULL, voltage DECIMAL(10,2) NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT station_id, STDDEV_SAMP(voltage) AS sample_spread FROM mini_station_voltage GROUP BY station_id ORDER BY station_id
